upstream.name: sfrxETH
upstream.unresolved_note: ⚠️ A live crvUSD collateral market and NO REPORT. We rate sfrxUSD but not sfrxETH.

upstream.name: WBTC
upstream.unresolved_note: ⚠️ Same WBTC gap as fxUSD's 89.7%-of-debt leg. A crvUSD collateral market, the custodial BTC wrapper, no report.

upstream.name: tBTC
upstream.unresolved_note: ⚠️ A live collateral market, no report. Also named in DUSD's collateral set.

upstream.name: LLAMMA — soft-liquidation AMM, collateral held in price bands
upstream.note: ⚠️ crvUSD does not hold collateral as a simple balance: LLAMMA distributes it across narrow price bands and soft-liquidates continuously. So collateral quality and the AMM's behaviour are not separable risks here, unlike a hard-liquidation CDP.

upstream.name: ⚠️ PegKeeper-minted crvUSD is NOT collateral-backed
upstream.note: ⚠️ This report states that PegKeeper crvUSD is PROTOCOL-MINTED, PROTOCOL-OWNED AND NOT BACKED BY COLLATERAL. So a share of supply has no upstream at all, and a lookthrough that assumes every unit is collateralised overstates the backing.

dependencies.upstream_resolution_rule: ⚠️ EVERY upstream entry carries exactly one resolution: `slug` / `slugs` / `terminal`+`kind` / `unresolved`. TERMINAL means nothing is missing; UNRESOLVED means a report is owed. Never merged.
dependencies.edge_kind_rule: `backing` = my SOLVENCY depends on it. `venue` = my EXIT PRICE does.

downstream_basis.asserted_only_note: None — every asserted edge is reproducible from an upstream array.
downstream_basis.do_not_hand_edit: ⚠️ downstream_tracked is GENERATED. Hand-maintaining both directions is how fxsave came to list fxUSD as BOTH its upstream and its downstream — one edge recorded twice, in opposite directions. Add the edge to the UPSTREAM array of the dependent asset and re-run build.
